world.title: Story Worldbuilding
world.subtitle: Shape your universe genre, summary, fundamental laws, magic/power systems, and factions.
highlights: Story genre and comprehensive world overview
Structured universe rules, magic/power systems, and factions
Automatic SHA-256 content hashing (WorldHash) for token-saving delta sync

characters.title: Character System
characters.subtitle: Standard profiles, alignment slider, dynamic custom sub-modules, and chronological progression logs.
highlights: Dynamic 'Add to Character' nested lists (Pets, Magical Items, Companions)
Append-only chronological Character History with chapter references

arc-board.title: Infinite Arc Board
arc-board.subtitle: Plot story arcs visually on an unbounded 2D canvas with event cards, notes, and directional arrows.
highlights: Infinite 2D pan & zoom powered by React Flow
Event cards, sticky notes, and directional connections
Clean detail modal for reading and editing long-form card notes

chapters.title: Chapters & Draft Editor
chapters.subtitle: Structured chapter slots, dedicated draft notes, compressed storage, and the 5-step AI writing engine.
highlights: Per-chapter Draft, Main Text, and Translated Texts tabs
Zstd/Gzip compressed BLOB storage for ultra-compact local manuscripts
Approval-locked 5-step AI writing flow with 20 styles & 10 registers

translation.title: Translation & Technical Glossary
translation.subtitle: Flexible source → target language translation guided by your lore-specific glossary rules.
highlights: Flexible source → target language pairs (TR ↔ EN and beyond)
Two-column Technical Terms Glossary (Term | Description & usage rules)

settings.subtitle: Manage application language, visual theme, local database status, and AI provider preferences.
